description: Export round-trip (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §10.7; interop/EXCEL_EXPORT_AND_REPLAY): a TreeCalc workspace converts to a WorkbookConstructionSpec (defined-names primary) and is verified against Excel. Round-trip fidelity is graduated — named-nodes-with-formulas survive; TreeCalc-novel surface does not. Executed via the W009 verify-workspace path (export -> OxXlPlay construct+observe -> OxReplay diff).

cases.name: named nodes with formulas round-trip cleanly
cases.note: Each path becomes a workbook/sheet-scoped defined name; the workspace re-imports equivalently and recomputes equal to Excel.

cases.name: TreeCalc-novel operators do not round-trip
cases.note: Formulas using novel surface error or lose semantics on save to Excel; bidirectional fidelity is a graduated promise (§10.7). (The accounts workspace is the host fixture; the assertion is the round-trip rule.)
